cheapest_decisive_test.action: One vectorised CPU pass over 24 preregistered cells on SIP daily bars: rank on the selection window only, report the untouched holdout and the SPMO-matched anchor window, then run each cell's declared placebos (1-20 session calendar shift x 20 seeds for gate and canary signals, random pick from the same menu x 60 seeds for ranked selections, random Dirichlet weights x 60 seeds for fixed-weight cells, random night subsets x 60 seeds for the overnight cells) plus the 20 bp stress view.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: If no family clears those gates, the census's headline numbers are an artifact of the sources' own windows and cost assumptions, and the giants route is closed for this regime rather than iterated on.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: At least one cell with anchor CAGR >= 50% and max drawdown <= 35% (or anchor Sharpe >= 2.0 with CAGR >= 30%), holdout Sharpe >= 1.0 and positive, every declared placebo beaten on at least 90% of seeds, and the same verdict at 20 bp per side.

cost_and_execution_assumptions: sum(|delta w|) * slippage charged on the execution session, 10 bp per side primary and 20 bp per side stress; signal on the close, filled at the next session's open; fully adjusted SIP daily bars; long-only US ETFs tradable on the existing Alpaca paper cron; no shorting, no options, no intraday, no VX futures. Fixed-weight cells let their weights drift between the published rebalance dates instead of being reset daily.
existing_solution_comparison: Every cell is somebody else's finished product: Composer runs three of them live on a platform, Allocate Smartly tracks the TAA family in near real time, HEDGEFUNDIE's allocation has a multi-year forum record and two of the rules are published papers. Nothing is re-derived. What none of them provides is an evaluation on our data with our next-open fills, our 10 and 20 bp cost views, a selection/holdout split and placebo controls, which is the only thing this iteration adds. Where a public number already exists it is recorded in the manifest's `reported` field and compared, not recomputed from scratch.
negative_experiments_checked: L-20260918-01 and L-20260918-05 already killed single moving-average timing of leveraged ETFs in this window on the calendar-shift placebo. H-20260918-05 found the S3 leveraged sleeve's ranking was weak evidence (25% placebo beat rate). H-20260922-04 ran the F3 3x-sector RSI-branch family and it was refuted, so F3 is excluded here rather than re-run. H-20260922-02 already covers the volatility-target and drawdown-brake overlays, so no overlay is re-searched. The families kept are the ones none of those runs touched, plus two explicitly labelled ablations that exist to let the same placebos kill them.
objective: Take the strategies that already have public records -- Composer symphonies, the Allocate Smartly TAA canon, the retail leveraged-ETF canon and two 2024-2026 academic rules -- and measure 24 of them verbatim under this project's frozen recent-window protocol, so that compute goes to deciding which published giant survives our costs, windows and placebos rather than to inventing another rule.

remaining_evidence_gap: Composer's discovery page shows winners only and lets authors reset the out-of-sample start; Allocate Smartly's recent numbers are paywalled and it tracks no leveraged variant; the leveraged-ETF canon's records are self-reported forum and blog backtests; the two academic rules publish no cost assumption. So for every family the missing evidence is the same: does the published rule still work in 2024-2026 after realistic costs, and is it the signal or the underlying asset that produced the return.

stop_condition: A cell is dropped when its placebo beats it on more than 10% of seeds, when it fails the holdout Sharpe gate, or when 20 bp per side removes its edge. The whole iteration stops at one CPU pass over 24 cells plus their placebos; no cell is re-tuned and no second grid is opened on the same holdout.
target_regime_and_horizon: The recent US regime only: a selection window of 2023-09-18..2025-12-31 and an untouched 2026 holdout, on daily bars, with a one- to twelve-month holding horizon depending on the family. No claim is made about pre-2022 regimes, and every cell is reported with its own applicability window rather than as a permanent edge.
